description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) has been ruled out for Week 8 for the New England Patriots according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Henderson will sit out while continuing to battle an illness that kept the running back from practicing throughout the week for head coach Mike Vrabel. Rhamondre Stevenson will receive as many touches as he can handle out of the backfield against the Dolphins Sunday.
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) ruled out for Week 8

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) has been ruled out for Week 8 for the New England Patriots according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Brown will sit out after being unable to practice throughout the week, leaving the New England passing attack without its primary weapon. Demario Douglas should see even more targets for head coach Mike Vrabel against the Dolphins Sunday.
items.title: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) ruled out for Week 8

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Commanders DT Daron Payne suffered a significant foot injury in practice on Friday that will knock him out for the foreseeable future.
items.impact: Payne will be further evaluated on Saturday. He is expected to be placed on injured reserve.
items.title: Daron Payne to miss significant time with foot injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: KaVontae Turpin has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Turpin remains off the fantasy radar when he is healthy.
items.title: KaVontae Turpin (ribs) ruled out Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: George Pickens is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Pickens was limited in practice throughout the week. He should be on the favorable side of questionable heading into Sunday.
items.title: George Pickens (shoulder/hamstring) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tyler Allgeier is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
items.impact: Allgeier will return to his depth role with Jeremiyah Love slated to return.
items.title: Tyler Allgeier (toe) off injury report Sunday

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.desc: The Seahawks D/ST allowed three points while notching one sack and forcing one turnover in a 20-3 win over the Chiefs in Week 7.
items.impact: Seattle's defense came to play in the impressive win over the previously undefeated Chiefs. The Seahawks intercepted Patrick Mahomes once in the contest. They will have another tough test ahead of them in Week 8 vs. the Bears.
items.title: Seahawks D/ST dominates Chiefs in Week 7

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Talanoa Hufanga has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Hufanga remains week-to-week.
items.title: Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) ruled out Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Waddle got in a pair of limited practices to end the week. He will be a borderline WR2/WR3 play for fantasy managers if he is cleared.
items.title: Jaylen Waddle (chest) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: RJ Harvey has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Harvey was a late addition to the injury report on Thursday. Jonah Coleman and J.K. Dobbins should both step into bigger roles in the Broncos backfield.
items.title: RJ Harvey (knee) ruled out Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Pat Surtain II is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Surtain will return in time for a crucial divisional matchup against Kansas City.
items.title: Pat Surtain II (ankle) off injury report Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Colston Loveland was limited in practice on Friday.
items.impact: Loveland was a late addition to the injury report. He will need to be monitored in practice on Saturday heading into Monday's game against the Seahawks.
items.title: Colston Loveland (neck) limited in practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kyle Monangai did not practice on Friday.
items.impact: Monangai hasn't played or practiced since Week 4. He appears likely to remain sidelined this week.
items.title: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) misses practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kerby Joseph has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Vikings.
